result.instructions: Tools for WiziShop, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which products are out of stock or hidden in my shop?"; "Show the orders from the last week that are not yet shipped."; "Find the customer with the email address on this order.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes WiziShop data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run wizishop_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run wizishop_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run wizishop_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. wizishop_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: wizishop_list_shops
tools.title: List WiziShop shops
tools.description: List the shops this WiziShop login can access, with their ids. Read only.

tools.name: wizishop_get_shop
tools.title: Get WiziShop shop
tools.description: Get one shop: name, domain, currency and status. Read only.

shop_id.description: Shop id. Default: the login's default shop (see wizishop_list_shops).

tools.name: wizishop_list_products
tools.title: List WiziShop products
tools.description: List products of a shop. Filter by status or SKU. Read only.

shop_id.description: Shop id. Default: the login's default shop (see wizishop_list_shops).

sort.description: Sort field, as WiziShop names it.

tools.name: wizishop_get_product
tools.title: Get WiziShop product
tools.description: Get one product with its fields, prices and stock. Read only.

shop_id.description: Shop id. Default: the login's default shop (see wizishop_list_shops).

tools.name: wizishop_list_orders
tools.title: List WiziShop orders
tools.description: List orders of a shop. Filter by status code range. Sort by a field, ascending or descending. Read only.

shop_id.description: Shop id. Default: the login's default shop (see wizishop_list_shops).

sort.description: Sort field, as WiziShop names it.

from_status_code.description: Only orders at or after this status code.

to_status_code.description: Only orders at or before this status code.

tools.name: wizishop_get_order
tools.title: Get WiziShop order
tools.description: Get one order with its lines, totals and status. Set is_public_id to look it up by its public id. Read only.

shop_id.description: Shop id. Default: the login's default shop (see wizishop_list_shops).

order_id.description: Order id, or its public id when is_public_id is true.

is_public_id.description: True when order_id is the public id.

sort.description: Sort field, as WiziShop names it.
